subject: [PATCH RESEND 2/7] locking/rwsem: track holders of opted-in rw_semaphores

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds a feature to track the holders of read-write semaphores (rw_semaphores) in Linux. It introduces a new flag, `tracked`, which is set when an rw_semaphore is opted-in for holder tracking. The count of holders is incremented when a task acquires the lock and decremented when it releases the lock. This feature is designed to help with debugging and troubleshooting by providing information about who holds a particular lock. It also includes support for PREEMPT_RT builds, which have a different locking mechanism. The patch modifies several kernel files to implement this new feature.
